blocking_methods.label: tollFree
blocking_methods.instructions: Call 18005998866 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.
Email helpdesk@tgcab.bank.in from your registered email to request card blocking.
Log in to internet banking at https://netbanking.tgcab.bank.in and use the card block/hotlist option.
Block via the bank's mobile app (Cards > Block/Hotlist). Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.infrasofttech.tsc | iOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/tscab/id1415635104

The bank publishes no dedicated card-block/hotlist page, no SMS block format and no overseas/NRI number, so call the published lines. Help Desk page lists Toll free 18005998866 with no hours stated; Customer Support lines +040 24685660 and +040 23443812 are answered only 8 am to 8 pm on working days. Email: helpdesk@tgcab.bank.in ('Drop a Mail' on the Help Desk page); info@tgcab.bank.in is also published site-wide in the footer. App: the official TGCAB Mobile Banking page and the site-wide 'Get our App' footer link the Android app com.infrasofttech.tsc and iOS app tscab (id1415635104); the page's published in-app service list includes 'Debit Card Controls' and 'Green Pin generation' alongside NEFT/IMPS/UPI. Website: the Internet Banking login portal https://netbanking.tgcab.bank.in, linked site-wide from the bank's Internet Banking page; that page's published feature list is only 'Balance enquiry', 'Account Statement', 'Loan Statement', 'Fixed Deposit Details' and 'Loan Certificate' - no card-block option among them, so no web card-block path is published. The bank issues only RuPay debit cards (RuPay ATM cum Debit Card and RuPay Platinum Card, per ATM Services).

The bank's official site publishes no credit-card product and no credit-card blocking channel: ATM Services states 'Apex Bank offers Rupay ATM cum Debit card and Rupay Platinum Card to its customers' (both debit cards), and every 'credit' reference on the fetched pages is a loan/merchant credit facility, not a card. The old entry's credit blocking methods (1800-100-4755, 040-23268725, info@tsabbank.com, tsabbank.com netbanking, app links com.tsab.app / id1526327863) could not be verified on any live official page - the tsabbank.com domain no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN, no Wayback snapshots) - and are dropped. The bank-wide contacts published under 'debit' are the only emergency lines available to any cardholder.
